name: Does dry rot affect my home's resale value?
description: Untreated dry rot can lower your home's resale value. Proactively addressing it and providing repair documentation can reassure buyers.

mainEntity.name: Does dry rot affect my home's resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, undetected or untreated dry rot can significantly impact your home's resale value. Potential buyers often perform detailed inspections, and discovery of dry rot can lead to reduced offers or scupper a sale entirely due to perceived structural issues and future repair costs. A key preparation step if selling your home is to address any known or suspected dry rot proactively; having professional repair documentation can demonstrate the issue has been competently resolved, reassuring potential buyers.
